searchDataSourceId.description: Data Source Id associated with this component.

caseSensitive.description: Whether the search should be case sensitive or not.

dataSource.description: The data source reference that will be filtered with the new query.

field.description: The value field for each result.

filterComparator.description: Comparator to use in the filter.

queryString.description: The query string that the data source will be filtered on.

searchFields.description: If the data source is a fetch call, the fields that the filter will search on.
